proposedEntry.name: better-layout
proposedEntry.description: Layout-structure guidance for web interfaces: grouping by negative space with a 2x inter/intra-group gap ratio, keeping controls visually distinct from static content, shared-edge alignment, logical (RTL-safe) properties over physical left/right, importance-ordered content, progressive-disclosure affordances (peeking scroll items, disclosure controls), breakpoints driven by content rather than device presets, container queries, safe-area-aware full-bleed vs. floating-control layering, and string-growth/clipping resilience, closing with a calibrated severity report ending in Block/Approve.
inputs: UI component or page source code
outputs: severity-ranked findings table (Severity | Location | Before | After | Why)
